root_motivation: - The predecessor's live AC 7 named `https://mcphost.dev/examples/sample-1000.csv`. At `j0yen/mcphost@21f6ad78` the only mention of that path in the tree is the AC's own text (`agent/intent-card.json:53`); nothing creates or serves it. The receipt (`runs/1055/live/ac7.md` on the build host, 4:26 PM PDT 10-24) reads `HTTP/2 404` via Caddy; at 8:04 PM PDT the URL still returned 404, read from the prod box itself. - Prod's Caddy site is generated by mcphost-deploy (`install.py:204 render_caddy_site` → per-route `handle` blocks from `www_routes.py`, catch-all `reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:{port}` at `install.py:191`). A file added under `www/` is mirrored to `/var/www/mcphost` but not served without a generated handle (`www_vendor.py:798` warns "no Caddy handle for route"). So a "docs/examples" file, which the predecessor's technical notes promised, could never have satisfied the AC. - The live verifier called `host_table_create` on the admin credential and was refused (`forbidden`, family...
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source ref and gets a scheduled mirror in one call; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt and knows both were rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the binary's static routes, When `GET /examples/sample-1000.csv` is requested, Then it answers 200 with `Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8`, the same `Cache-Control` as `/llms.txt`, and a body byte-identical to `examples/database-in-a-minute/fixture.csv` (header plus 1,000 data rows)

Given every absolute example-fixture URL (`/examples/<file>` on the public origin) found under `agent/`, `recipes/`, `www/`, `docs/` and `examples/`, When the route drift test runs, Then each path is a route in the binary's static-route table, and the test fails on a URL that has none

Given `scripts/live/tblurlp_import_live.py` and the loopback harness app serving its own fixture route, When the driver runs with `--base-url http://127.0.0.1:<port>` (harness signup or `--key-file`), Then its last line starts with `fixture_http=200 rows_imported=1000 count=1000 is_error=0` and it exits 0, and `--plan` prints the steps with no network call

Given prod `/mcp`, When the committed driver signs up a synthetic tenant (`x-mcphost-synthetic: synthorg-tblurlp`), creates `tblurlp_ac04` from `source_url` `https://mcphost.dev/examples/sample-1000.csv`, counts it and offboards, Then the row passes (Live; evidence: `~/.local/state/mcphost-live/tblurlp-ac04-results.jsonl` last row `summary` `fixture_http=200 rows_imported=1000 count=1000 is_error=0 offboarded=1`)

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the hand-written `## Give Claude a database in one minute` section of `www/llms.txt` (the generated `recipe:database-in-a-minute` block stays generator-owned), When an agent reads it, Then the one-call form (`host_table_create` with `source_url` `https://mcphost.dev/examples/sample-1000.csv`) comes before the batched-append step, and the AC 2 drift test covers that URL

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: the SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, and the trigger tick's sync pass writing a not_implemented sync_runs receipt.
migrations/0130_syncs.sql: syncs and sync_runs tables; Plan.syncs_max (free 5, pro 50) and the quota_syncs_max, connection_missing and schedule_too_frequent error codes.
www/llms.txt gains a generated Data sync section and docs/tools.md the source.kind enum, both rendered from SourceKind.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling (the two-way PRD); type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.main_database_tables: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not a per-tenant file, so the tick's sync pass is one indexed query across tenants.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not keep a host table equal to a sheet?
five_whys_trace.a: No verb registers an external source; the agent would own a puller, a token and a diff loop.
host.table.append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool.
One SourceKind enum generates the schema, docs and dispatch, so the five kinds cannot drift.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is source.secret?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The NAME of a host.secret (stored as secret_name), never a value, so no secret-named field exists on a Debug struct.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Do push and two_way modes run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: They are accepted at create with status pending_mode (the PRD default) and the tick skips them.
